english.title: Transport worker fail to provide breath test
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required to provide a specimen of breath for a breath test pursuant to section 29 of the Transport and Works Act 1992, failed, without reasonable excuse, to do so.
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 29(5) and 36(1) of the Transport and Works Act 1992.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: Section 30 of the Transport and Works Act 1992 empowers the police to enter any place, if need be by force, in order to effect the arrest

other.powersofarrest: Section 30(1) provides:- A constable may arrest a person without warrant if he has reasonable cause to suspect that that person is or has been committing an offence under section 27(1) unfit to work through drink or drugs.
other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
